items.title: George Henderson Interview, 1961-05-03
items.who: Mrs. George Henderson (wife of George Henderson)

ctx.x: Dad is standing up here in my house. He said, but I can't be all your spots. Yeah. I mean, he'd stay over the lake.

ctx.s: Mrs. George Henderson (wife of George Henderson)
ctx.x: I was too little. He lived here when I was a little girl about seven years old and he traveled with Bay. And he never did come back until he was a man. In other words, he deserted my own. My own dad, grief, worn over me. Because when he traveled, he went away and she never went away from me more. And so we learned in later years he had married after Philip Delphan, but he wasn't divorced. And he came back since that because I'm the picture of his wife. Oh, is that true? Yeah. I'm the picture of his wife.
